geos.label: South Bay
geos.blurb: San Jose, Saratoga, Sunnyvale, Mountain View

meta.standfirst: Arts, music, and worthwhile oddities, ordered by remove from Mountain View.

events.title: SOB x RBE, Plo, 310babii, Mistah F.A.B.
events.venue: Habbas Law Epicenter at PayPal Park
events.note: Bay Area hip-hop — Vallejo's SOB x RBE headline a regional showcase.

events.title: San Jose Giants home game
events.note: Cheap tickets, minor-league atmosphere.

events.title: Los Altos Thursday concert
events.note: Upbeat family-oriented pop and rock; picnic-style.

events.title: Summer Concert Series
events.note: Cover bands and local acts. Lawn seating.

events.title: Valencia LIVE!
events.note: Mission District street party. Multiple blocks of live performance across the corridor.

events.title: yeat with BNYX
events.note: Rage rap and trap — processed vocals, distorted synth-bass, cavernous production.

events.title: Take 6
events.note: A cappella gospel and jazz vocal harmony — six voices, no instruments.

events.title: Flore Laurentienne
events.note: Neoclassical and ambient orchestral in a deconsecrated church. Strings and synthesizer washes.

events.title: Will Swinton
events.note: Indie folk and singer-songwriter — Australian, spare and melodic.

events.title: Alex Amen and Double Helix Peace Treaty
events.note: Indie and experimental pop.

events.title: Caravan 222, The Ugly, Country Risqué
events.note: Garage rock and alt-country — scrappy local triple bill. Venue closes at end of year.

events.title: NightLife (21+)
events.note: Live DJ or band each week alongside the exhibits; genre varies.

events.title: Peabo Bryson
events.note: Classic R&B balladry — two-time Grammy winner, immaculate vocal control.

events.title: Oakland Ballers home game
events.note: Independent-league ball in a small West Oakland park. Cheap, weird, charming.

events.title: Etana
events.note: Reggae — Jamaican vocalist, roots-conscious songwriting with a soul edge. 60–75 min from Mountain View.

events.title: Cosmic Gate
events.note: Trance — German duo, two decades in the genre's top tier.

events.title: San Jose Giants + fireworks
events.note: Friday night includes the season's fireworks program.

events.title: Fleetwood Mask
events.note: Fleetwood Mac tribute on an outdoor stage in the estate meadow. Arrive early and walk the gardens.

events.title: Music on the Square
events.note: Weekly free series in the downtown square. Food and bars right there.

events.title: Chinatown Night Market
events.note: Voted top night market in the country two years running. Food, shopping, live entertainment.

events.title: Bay Area International Deaf Dance Festival
events.note: Choreography built for visual rhythm rather than audible beat — a different formal logic than most dance you'll see.

events.title: Tomahawk and Melvins
events.note: Experimental metal and sludge — Mike Patton's art-metal project with the band that invented this lineage of heaviness.

events.title: Frak w/ Del the Funky Homosapien, Guapdad 4000, G-Eazy, Nef the Pharoah, Mistah F.A.B.
events.note: Unusually deep local lineup spanning three generations of Bay Area rap. Best hip-hop bill of the weekend.

events.title: Man Man with American Tomahawk
events.note: Carnivalesque instrumentation, unhinged vocals, junkyard percussion.

events.title: What So Not
events.note: Future bass — Australian producer, melodic drops and heavy sound design. Outdoor stage.

events.title: The Gallery, Carrellee, Skotos
events.note: Proper club programming — house and techno.

events.title: PLOSIVS and Tijuana Panthers
events.note: Post-punk and surf-garage. PLOSIVS features members of Drive Like Jehu and Pinback.

events.title: Yoasobi
events.note: J-pop — novel-to-song adaptations, virtuosic vocal lines.

events.title: Rappin' 4-Tay with RBL Posse
events.note: Bay Area rap — mid-90s Fillmore-district lineage.

events.title: Friday Nights at OMCA
events.note: Outdoor programming free 5–9pm; regular admission for galleries. Food trucks, rotating Bay Area acts.

events.title: Second Friday Artwalk
events.note: Studio and gallery openings across the district.

events.title: Nightcap En Blanc
events.note: Rooftop jazz and R&B, all-white dress code. Runs through Aug 26.

events.title: Atmosphere w/ The Pharcyde, DJ Abilities, Abstract Rude
events.note: Underground hip-hop — Rhymesayers-era Midwest rap with West Coast alternative pioneers, in an open-air quarry on the UCSC campus. The single best argument for leaving the corridor. ~45 min over Highway 17.

events.title: The Polish Ambassador
events.note: Downtempo and funk-inflected electronic; small room in the redwoods.

events.title: Penny and Sparrow with Cece Coakley
events.note: Indie folk — close male harmony, literary lyrics, spare arrangements.

events.title: Toto, Christopher Cross, The Romantics
events.note: Yacht rock and classic pop-rock — Toto's session-musician precision, Cross's soft-rock catalog, The Romantics' power-pop. Five minutes from home.

events.title: The Movement and Pepper with Cydeways
events.note: Reggae-rock and dub-pop in a hillside outdoor setting, roughly 25 minutes out.

events.title: San Jose Giants home game
events.note: Minor-league ball downtown.

events.title: Head West Marketplace
events.note: Curated local artists, vintage dealers, designers, and makers. Live acoustic sets alongside.

events.title: Public Enemy with DJ Davey D
events.note: The most consequential protest rap group in the genre's history, with the Bay's own Davey D DJing. Extraordinary booking for a free show. Lottery-ticketed; arrive early, dress for fog.

events.title: Dahlia Society of California Annual Show
events.venue: Hall of Flowers, Golden Gate Park
events.note: Growers statewide bring their best blooms, judged in all categories. The competitive-horticulture subculture is its own reward.

events.title: Pizza, Bagel, and Beer Festival
events.note: Exactly what it says. North Beach setting makes it walkable between vendors.

events.title: Quicksand, Bane, Soul Blind
events.note: Post-hardcore — Quicksand are foundational to the genre's melodic wing. Unusual to see this in a movie palace.

events.title: Merola Grand Finale
events.note: Arias, ensembles, and scenes showcasing the program's emerging artists. Optional post-show reception with the singers.

events.title: CORTIS
events.note: K-pop, first of two nights.

events.title: Gallant and Stefan Mahendra
events.note: Alt-R&B — falsetto-driven, atmospheric production.

events.title: Thee Sacred Souls, LA LOM, The Womack Sisters
events.note: Retro soul and Chicano soul — unhurried Daptone-style soul, instrumental cumbia and boleros, and a legendary soul family name. Best-curated outdoor bill of the weekend.

events.title: 311, Dirty Heads, Ocean Alley
events.note: Reggae-rock and alt-rock. Big, sunny, uncomplicated.

events.title: J. Holiday
events.note: Contemporary R&B in a slow-jam register.

events.title: Ani DiFranco with Valerie June
events.note: Folk-punk and singer-songwriter. DiFranco's percussive open-tuned guitar; Valerie June opens with an Appalachian-soul hybrid worth arriving early for.

events.title: The Head and the Heart with Linus Hablot
events.note: Indie folk-rock — harmony-forward, anthemic, well suited to an outdoor evening.

events.title: San Jose Giants home game
events.note: Sunday afternoon ball.

events.title: David Lee Roth
events.note: The Van Halen frontman in a restored 500-cap room, which is a genuinely strange and appealing scale for him.

events.title: Fleetwood Mask
events.note: Fleetwood Mac tribute, second of two nights on the estate's outdoor stage.

events.title: Concerts at Rinconada Park
events.note: Playground adjacent. Easy family option.

events.title: Concerts at Mitchell Park
events.note: Family favorites and tribute bands — broad, singalong-friendly.

events.title: Al Green with Goapele and The Glide Ensemble
events.note: Season closer. One of the defining voices of American soul, with Oakland neo-soul and a San Francisco gospel choir opening. Lottery-ticketed; biggest crowds of the season.

events.title: Dahlia Society Annual Show, day two
events.venue: Hall of Flowers, Golden Gate Park
events.note: Second day of the statewide dahlia competition.

events.title: Lindy in the Park
events.note: Swing and big band records for open-air Lindy Hop. Free beginner lesson, no partner needed.

events.title: Take 6
events.note: Second engagement of the weekend.

events.title: CORTIS
events.note: K-pop, night two.

events.title: Dillinger Four with Off With Their Heads
events.note: Melodic punk — Minneapolis institution, rarely tours. Venue closes at end of year.

events.title: Bensley
events.note: Drum and bass — technical, high-energy.

events.title: Oakland Pride Parade & Festival
events.note: Parade plus a full downtown festival footprint. Lady Alma and David Harness headline. Plan transit, not parking — drive to Fremont or Union City BART and ride in.

events.title: Passion Pit
events.note: Indie electro-pop — falsetto vocals over bright synth maximalism.

events.title: Concerts at the Lake: Oakland Municipal Band
events.note: Thirty-five pieces, Kaitlin Bove conducting. Marches, light classical, show tunes. Over a century of continuous seasons.

events.title: Roller Disco Daze, final day
events.note: Free community roller rink with themed nights, lawn games, art installations. Last day of the run.
